subject: Follower
text: The Follower boss attacks for 30-40 damage, casts Frost and Drowsy, uses Grin to confuse party members, and can cast Stronger to heal.

evidence.quote: He only does 30-40 damage with each attack, and his Frost spell is super-weak. He has a Drowsy spell, but it hardly ever works. What really pisses me off is when he uses Grin on Aguro...Sometimes if you get him low enough he'll use Stronger, which is a pain, but it doesn't even heal him 100 HP, which is only 2 attacks from me.
